entries.proposition: 🔴 THIS PAPER CONTAINS A HETEROZYGOTE ARM WITH A GRADED, SUB-CLINICAL ELECTROPHYSIOLOGICAL PHENOTYPE, AND NOTHING IN THE CORPUS RECORDS IT. One Wwox allele is not silent in the neocortex: 17% of slices from heterozygous animals burst where no control slice does, against 86% in the homozygous conditional.

findings.finding: The paper's '730 upregulated and 579 downregulated genes (P-value < 0.01, fold change > 1.5)' reproduces EXACTLY from this sheet — but only on the UNADJUSTED p-value and the unshrunk log2 fold change. Recounted: p<0.01 & |log2FC|>log2(1.5) gives 730 up / 579 down; the same filter on the shrunken estimate the authors also supply gives 488 / 388; and on the adjusted p-value (padj<0.01) it gives 281 / 280. The headline DEG count is therefore an uncorrected one in a paper that states no multiple-comparison correction anywhere.

Of the 23 genes the running text lists as significantly downregulated in Fig. 3E, 21 have padj < 0.01 in this sheet; TWO DO NOT: Enpp2 padj = 0.281 and Myrf padj = 0.134 (Mag is 0.0355, significant but above 0.01). Myrf matters: it is the myelin regulatory factor, and the maturation-block reading leans on it.

The per-sample columns show the design is UNBALANCED and the imbalance is not stated in the paper: S-KO 3 cortex + 3 hippocampus, S-Control 4 cortex + 2 hippocampus. Wwox itself: log2FC -1.86, padj 1.69e-8, with residual normalised counts in S-KO cortex (172.74 / 187.02 / 331.42) an order of magnitude above S-KO hippocampus (18.82 / 18.82 / 28.01) — Synapsin-Cre deletion is far from complete in cortex at the transcript level, and the paper never says so.

The pooled hippocampal comparison (null + N-KO + S-KO against WT + N-Control + S-Control) gives Wwox log2FC -3.14, padj 2.9e-32, and the per-sample columns un-pool it: residual Wwox counts are 28.29 / 32.45 in the constitutive null, 5.06 / 25.52 in N-KO and 32.52 / 33.04 / 49.01 in S-KO against 294-307 in WT. The three genotypes are NOT graded on residual transcript; they are saturated together, which is an argument the paper could have made and does not.

Read row by row. 13 mouse and 6 human primer pairs, all oligodendrocyte/myelin genes: there is NO Wwox primer pair and no housekeeping pair, although the supplementary methods name 'HPRT or UBC'. Ten primary antibodies; the anti-WWOX row carries dilution 1:5000 with catalogue 'N.A' and an EMPTY source cell, in a table whose nine other rows are populated — an authorial declaration of absence. Three secondaries only (anti-mouse 488, anti-mouse 647, anti-rat Cy5) and NO anti-rabbit secondary at all, although four primaries are rabbit (WWOX, MBP, NG2, GFAP) and all four are imaged in published panels; no DAPI or Hoechst is listed although Hoechst is labelled in Supplementary Fig. 1 and Figure 6C.
